correctness.summary: Schatten Hölder makes all quartic trace words trace class. Direct expansion and cyclicity prove Tr([A*,A][B*,B]) = ||[A*,B]||_2^2 for commuting A,B in S4. Pairwise summation gives the exact Gram/energy identity. For Hilbert-Schmidt inputs, positivity plus trace zero forces the summed self-commutator to vanish, after which the energy identity gives all cross-commutators zero.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The recent source explicitly leaves general sum-normal normality open and only records a trace-class sum-hyponormal-to-sum-normal observation. Searches around the source, products of self-commutators, cross-commutators, Hilbert-Schmidt/Schatten conditions, Curto-Jian's matricial identity, and Misra-Pramanick-Sinha's trace inequality did not locate the exact S4 energy identity or its stated consequences. Older Hilbert-module or Schatten commutator literature remains a residual bibliographic risk.

value.summary: The exact identity answers the new sum-normal question on the full Schatten-four class, yields a positive-semidefinite Gram matrix of squared cross-commutator norms, and upgrades the source paper's trace-class observation to normality for Hilbert-Schmidt sum-hyponormal tuples.

limitations: The Schatten-four hypothesis is sufficient but is not claimed optimal.
Arbitrary compact sum-normal and sum-hyponormal tuples are not resolved.
No counterexample beyond S4 and no optimal Schatten threshold is claimed.
Older or poorly indexed Hilbert-module and Schatten cross-commutator literature may contain equivalent special cases.
Independent audit has not been performed.
